Question: A penetration tester has compromised a Windows server and is attempting to achieve persistence. Which of the following would achieve that goal?

Choices:
1. regedit /s sv.reg
2. reg delete sv.reg
3. reg query HKLM\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run /s
4. windir\\\\somefolder\\\\somefile.bat
5. net start svchost.bat
6. reg save HKLM\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\Sv.reg (Correct Answer)

To achieve persistence on a compromised Windows server, the penetration tester can use the "reg save" command to save the desired registry key into a file. This way, the key will be automatically loaded by the system upon reboot, allowing the persistence to be maintained.

Please let me know if there is anything else I can assist you with!
